text:
A coat of ink and ivory, stark and bright,
The zebra stands, a living work of art.
Within the garden’s hush, the shadows light,
And nature speaks a soft, unspoken part.

The flowers bloom with promises untold,
Their petals unfurl in silent grace,
Revealing splendor, brave and bold,
A hidden beauty in their gentle face.

The trees stand guard, with leaves that softly sigh,
Whispering wisdom from the ancient past,
Beneath the vast and open, azure sky,
Where time moves slow and seasons hold their cast.

Here solace finds the weary heart and mind,
In simple growth, in cycles deep and true,
Where every leaf that falls, and every bloom,
Reveals the story of the passing view.
